description: This file contains an ASP.NET Core Web API controller named OrganisationsController, which manages CRUD operations for Organisation entities, including creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting organisations.

classes.name: OrganisationsController
classes.description: API controller for managing Organisation entities with endpoints for creation, update, retrieval, and deletion.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new Organisation entity, saving it to the database and returning the created entity.

methods.name: UpdateOne
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing Organisation by ID.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of Organisations, optionally filtered by 'kind' and limited by 'limit'.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a single Organisation by ID, including related entities.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an Organisation by ID and records audit data.
